title: 第2354章 拆解域门设阵黑风第2353章 助凡悟阵意外惊喜
content_zh:
“此事不难。”
凡九收敛喜色，凝神看向阵基，笃定回道：“只需将此地法阵的核心基石逐一拆解、稳妥封存，完整运送回黑风山，再依照原本排布轨迹精准拼接复位，便可顺利启用。”
“就这般简单？”
莫凡微微一怔，随即生出一念，蹙眉问道：“既然只是拆解重组，那朕索性将这片承载法阵的大地直接挪移带走，岂不是更为省事？
连重新拼接基石的工序都可省去？”
听闻此言，凡九连忙摇头，面露正色，细细解释其中玄机，语气带着对阵道规则的敬畏：“帝君有所不知，此等上古域门，早已与下方地脉、整片大地深度勾连、浑然一体。”
“阵扎根于地，地承托于阵，牵一发而动全身。
若是强行挪移土层、损毁地脉根基，整座法阵的本源联系便会瞬间紊乱断裂，万千阵纹直接崩解失效。”
“而且此等顶级跨域法阵，基石排布看似固定，实则暗藏天地变数、时空序列，并非死板静止。
寻常修士哪怕原样复刻位置，也绝不可能还原其中的道韵衔接，最终只会得到一堆废石残纹，根本无法重铸域门。
强行挪地，终究只是痴人说梦。”
莫凡闻言一脸无奈，听得满头雾水，完全摸不透这上古阵道的繁复玄机。
他摆了摆手，撇嘴轻叹：“罢了，这般晦涩门道，果然还是交由你专人专办最为稳妥。”
“动手吧。”
话音落下，莫凡身形一晃，瞬即撤出法阵范围，静静立于半空观望。
他本以为拆解整座上古域门法阵，工序繁杂、耗时良久，谁知下一刻，只见凡九袖袍轻轻一拂，阵地上无数厚重古朴的法阵基石应声震颤，尽数腾空而起，化作道道流光，井然有序地掠入他的储物袖中。
不过瞬息之间，方才恢弘盘踞的域门阵基便被拆解一空，地面只剩平整遗迹，干净利落。
“这就……拆完了？”
一旁值守的锋朔与岩仑双双怔住，眼底满是错愕，万万没想到这等顶尖上古大阵，拆解起来竟如此轻而易举。
“不过是拆解搬移阵基，算不得什么难事。”

凡九微微耸肩，语气淡然，随即神色一肃，郑重补道：“但真正的难点，在于重组复原。
此阵涉及法则适配、纹路排序、序列变幻，一环错则全盘崩，差之毫厘便谬以千里，难度天差地别。”
两大圣修罗听得似懂非懂，云里雾里，只得含糊点头：“行吧，你是阵道大家，你说便是。”
凡九见二人一脸茫然，俨然是对牛弹琴，索性闭口不再多做解释。
“走吧，回黑风山。”
莫凡随口吩咐一句，随即看向锋朔、岩仑二人，沉声安排道：“此地域门已尽数迁移，再无驻守价值。
你二人即刻带上所有值守修士，一同折返朝堂复命。”
“属下遵帝君旨意！”
两大圣修罗齐齐躬身领命。
莫凡唇角微扬，心念一动，周身空冥世界之力悄然流转，顺势裹挟着凡九的身形，空间瞬间重合折叠。
下一瞬，两人身影已然凭空挪移，稳稳落于黑风山中央广场之上。
凡九双脚落地，抬眼望着周遭熟悉的壮阔广场、往来穿梭的各方高阶修士，以及不远处矗立高耸的时空古塔，整个人彻底陷入震撼。
content_en:
"It's not difficult."
Fanjiu restrained his joy, looked at the formation base with concentration, and replied firmly: "We only need to dismantle the core foundation stones of the formation one by one, seal them securely, transport them completely back to Black Wind Mountain, and then accurately splice and reset them according to the original arrangement, and then they can be put into use smoothly."
"Is it that simple?"
Mo Fan was slightly startled, then had a thought, frowned and asked: "Since it is just dismantling and reorganizing, wouldn't it be easier for me to simply move the land that holds the magic circle away?
Can even the process of re-joining the foundation stones be omitted? "
Hearing this, Fanjiu shook his head quickly, with a serious look on his face, and explained the mystery in detail, with a tone of awe of the rules of the Tao: "The emperor is unaware that these ancient domain gates have long been deeply connected and integrated with the earth below and the entire land."
"The formation is rooted in the ground, and the ground supports the formation. A single move can move the whole body.
If the soil is forcibly moved and the foundation of the earth veins is damaged, the original connection of the entire array will be instantly disrupted and broken, and thousands of array patterns will directly collapse and fail. "
“Furthermore, the arrangement of the cornerstones of such top-level cross-domain magic formations may appear to be fixed, but in fact, it hides the variables of heaven and earth and the sequence of time and space, and is not rigid and static.
Even if ordinary monks carve the exact location, they will never be able to restore the Taoist connection. In the end, they will only end up with a pile of waste stone and residual patterns, unable to recast the domain gate at all.
Forcibly moving the land is ultimately just wishful thinking. "
Mo Fan had a helpless look on his face when he heard this. He was completely confused and could not figure out the complicated mysteries of this ancient formation.
He waved his hand, curled his lips and sighed softly: "That's all, for such an obscure door, it is best to leave it to your dedicated person."
"Let's do it."
As soon as the words fell, Mo Fan swayed and immediately withdrew from the circle, standing quietly in mid-air and watching.
He originally thought that dismantling the entire ancient domain gate formation would be a complicated and time-consuming process, but who would have thought that at the next moment, with a slight flick of Fan's nine-sleeved robe, countless thick and simple cornerstones of the formation on the formation trembled, and all of them rose into the air, turning into streams of light, and swept into his storage sleeves in an orderly manner.
But in an instant, the domain gate formation base that had just been magnificently entrenched was dismantled, leaving only flat ruins on the ground, clean and tidy.
"Is it...done?"
Feng Shuo and Yan Lun, who were on guard at the side, were both stunned, their eyes full of astonishment. They never expected that such a top ancient formation could be dismantled so easily.
"It's just dismantling and moving the formation base, it's not a difficult task."
Fan Jiu shrugged slightly and spoke indifferently, then looked solemn and added solemnly: "But the real difficulty lies in reorganization and recovery.
This formation involves law adaptation, texture sorting, and sequence changes. If one link is wrong, the whole thing will collapse. A slight difference can lead to a huge error. The difficulty varies greatly. "
The two great saints Shura seemed to understand. They were confused and could only nod vaguely: "Okay, you are a master of the array, you can say whatever you want."
Fanjiu saw that the two of them had blank faces, as if they were talking to a cow, so he simply kept silent and didn't explain any more.
"Let's go back to Black Wind Mountain."
Mo Fan gave a casual order, then looked at Feng Shuo and Yan Lun, and said in a deep voice: "All the gates in this area have been moved, and there is no longer any value for garrisoning.
You two immediately take all the monks on duty and return to the court together. "
"I obey the emperor's will!"
The two great saints asuras both bowed and accepted the order.
The corner of Mo Fan's lips slightly raised, and with a thought, the power of the void and underworld around him quietly circulated, wrapping around Fan Jiu's figure, and the space instantly overlapped and folded.
The next moment, the two figures had moved out of thin air and landed steadily on the central square of Black Wind Mountain.
Fanjiu landed on his feet and looked up at the familiar grand square, the high-level monks coming and going, and the towering ancient tower of time and space not far away. His whole body was completely shocked.
